caption: A rolled-up rug is given a push and unrolls across a wooden floor, and the rug lies flat.

sa.check: A rolled-up rug is on a wooden floor.
The push comes first, then the unrolling, then the rug lies flat.

pc.expect: The roll travels in the direction of the push, slows, and stops when the rug runs out.
pc.fail: It rolls back toward the push; or keeps rolling past the rug's end; or stops dead mid-rug with nothing in its way.

pc.expect: The roll gets thinner as it travels and the unrolled part lies flat behind it.
pc.fail: The roll stays thick; or the rug rolls back up; or the unrolled part curls up.

pc.expect: It moves only after the push.
pc.fail: It unrolls before the push; or re-rolls; or slides sideways.

pc.expect: It lies on the floor, not through it.
pc.fail: It passes through the floor; or the layers run into one another; or it floats.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rug's pattern and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The pattern changes; or the floorboards shift; or the room rearranges.
